footer.about: JobKavach checks job offers, Telegram tasks and WhatsApp messages for scams – before you pay. Free, simple and in your language.
footer.tip1: Never pay money to get a job.
footer.tip2: "Like and earn" tasks are always a trap.
footer.tip3: Real HR never uses Gmail or only WhatsApp.
footer.tip4: Never share OTP, UPI PIN or screen.
footer.emergencyNote: Lost money? Call 1930 within the first hour – banks can often freeze it.

actions.call1930Aria: Call the national cyber fraud helpline 1930
actions.shareText: ⚠️ JobKavach result: {{verdict}}. {{summary}} Never pay money to get a job. If you lost money, call 1930.
actions.feedbackThanks: Thank you! Your feedback makes JobKavach better.

task.0: Next they will pay you a small amount to win your trust. It is bait.
task.1: Next they will move you to a private Telegram group. Do not join.
task.2: Next they will ask you to deposit money for a "prepaid task". Do not pay.
task.3: Next they will say your account is frozen and ask for a bigger amount. Do not pay.
task.4: Next they will likely ask you to pay a 'tax' to withdraw. Do not pay.
task.5: They will keep asking for more. Stop paying now and call 1930 immediately.

likeEarn.title: "Like videos and earn"
likeEarn.text: You get paid ₹50–150 to like YouTube videos. It's the opening hook of the biggest Telegram scam.
likeEarn.sign: Sign: easy money for liking or subscribing

prepaidTask.title: Prepaid / merchant tasks
prepaidTask.text: After small payouts they ask you to deposit money to unlock bigger tasks – then the money is gone.

fakeOffer.title: Fake offer letters
fakeOffer.text: A big company's name on a letter that asks for a registration fee, laptop deposit or ID card charge.

dataEntry.title: Work-from-home data entry
dataEntry.text: Typing or form-filling jobs that charge a joining fee or later claim you made "errors" and demand a penalty.

reviewRating.title: Review and rating jobs
reviewRating.text: Rate hotels, products or maps for money. The same script as task scams with a new story.

privateGroup.title: VIP Telegram groups
privateGroup.text: Groups full of fake members posting big "earnings" so you feel safe paying.

crypto.title: Crypto investment tasks
crypto.text: "Tasks" that turn into investing in a crypto app you can never withdraw from.
crypto.sign: Sign: an app or website you never heard of

auth.panelText: Thousands of students and homemakers lose money to fake jobs every day. JobKavach helps you spot the trap early.

landing.subtitle: Paste a job post, Telegram chat or offer letter. JobKavach spots task scams and fake offers, tells you what they will ask next, and helps you report in one tap.
landing.howSubtitle: Four simple steps. No technical knowledge needed.
landing.step1Text: Add a screenshot, chat, offer letter, or paste the message or link.
landing.step2Text: We read the text, check the company with MCA and look up payment IDs.
landing.step3Text: Scam, suspicious or genuine – with the exact warning signs.
landing.step4Text: Call 1930 or file on cybercrime.gov.in with an auto-filled report.
landing.typesSubtitle: These scripts are copied again and again. Learn the signs.
landing.testimonial1: I was about to pay ₹8,500 to "unfreeze" my task account. JobKavach showed me this was the exact scam script. I called 1930 the same day.
landing.testimonial2: My mother got an "Amazon work from home" message. The Hindi explanation made it easy for her to understand.
landing.testimonial3: The offer letter looked real, but the company was not found in MCA records and the HR used Gmail.
